purpose: Teach: 桐/天狗/ダニ/シティー/飛び込み/海水浴/リハビリテーション/ヘビ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが桐の箪笥を大事にしてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother really treasures that paulownia chest. It means something to her.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Gentle preamble — not lecturing. Pause before the second thought. Warm regard for the grandmother, inviting Sho into understanding something quietly important.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、天狗のお祭りに行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to the tengu festival!
lines.style: Bright, eager leap upward on the final word. Quick intake of breath before speaking. The unselfconscious brightness of a six-year-old who doesn't yet know how to modulate his wants.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家にダニがいないか確認しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's check the house for mites, shall we? Just to be sure.
lines.style: Practical and kind. Matter-of-fact opening, then softens at the end. Speaking to him as someone capable, not someone to be managed. Steady presence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとシティーホテルに泊まったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I stayed at a city hotel with Dad!
lines.style: Rushing slightly with excitement. Lift on the hotel part — the novelty of it. Eager to share something he thinks is important. Small, genuine brightness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、プールで飛び込みの練習しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, we should practice diving at the pool together, don't you think?
lines.style: Warm invitation rather than instruction. Slow, patient opening. Slight smile in the voice. Not pushing — offering. The tenderness of including him in something.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、家族と海水浴に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go swimming in the ocean with my family!
lines.style: Unbridled excitement building through the line. Small voice, big want. Slightly out of breath. The enthusiasm of someone who hasn't learned yet to soften his own joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがリハビリテーションに通われてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather has been going to rehabilitation. He's doing his best.
lines.style: Quiet dignity in the observation. Respectful pause after the first thought. Speaking to invite Sho into care rather than worry. Steady, unrushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、動物園でヘビを見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a snake at the zoo!
lines.style: Close and intimate, like sharing a small secret. Soft excitement — not loud, but real. Trusting her with the thing he saw. The warmth of telling an older sister something he knows she'll take seriously.
